sample_mapping_evidence: Six explicit source donor IDs atDay0/Day7;12PBMCblood observations. RNA cohort subset, not all participants in the publication. R/NR is follow-up vaccine response.

source_processing: Cell Ranger 3.0.1 (http://10xgenomics.com) was used to process Chromium single cell 5’ RNA-seq output. First, “cellranger mkfastq” demultiplexed the sequencing samples based on the 8bp sample index read to generate fastq files for the Read1 and Read2, followed by extraction of 16bp cell barcode and 10bp UMI. Second, “cellranger count” aligned the Read2 to the human reference genome (GRCh38) using STAR. Then,  aligned reads were used to generate data matrix only when they have valid barcodes and UMI, map to exons without PCR duplicates. Valid cell barcodes were defined based on UMI distribution.
Supplementary files format and content: Tab-separated values files and matrix files

title: I-0845_Day0_NR
extract_protocol_ch1: For the single cell analysis, cryopreserved PBMCs derived from three responders and three non-responders taken before and 7 days post vaccination were thawed and re-stimulated with the antigen mix as described above for the flow cytometry approach. Subsequently CD45-expressing cells were sorted and subjected loaded onto a well on a 10x Chromium Single Cellinstrument (10x Genomics).

The cDNA libraries were constructed using the 10x Chromium™ Single cell 5’ Library Kit according to the manufacturer’s original protocol. Libraries were sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 2x50 paired-end kits using the following read length: 26 bp Read1 for cell barcode and UMI, 8 bp I7 index for sample index  and 89 bp Read2 for transcript.
